name: Big Bear Lake
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Big Bear Lake, CA 2026
seo_desc: Big Bear Lake Christmas events for kids in 2026: Village tree lighting, Wild Lights, Santa's Village and Santa at Lake Arrowhead Village.
lede: Big Bear Lake and the San Bernardino Mountains turn snowy for Christmas, with a Village tree lighting, zoo lights and Santa visits up the mountain.
celebrates: Big Bear Lake celebrates Christmas with a mountain feel. The City of Big Bear Lake lights the tree at Christmas Tree Corner in the Village the day after Thanksgiving, and the Big Bear Alpine Zoo glows with Wild Lights through January 3 and welcomes Santa Paws on two December Saturdays. A community Festival of Lights contest turns the valley into a driving tour all month. Farther up Highway 18 and 189, SkyPark at Santa's Village and The Lake Arrowhead Village add Santa visits, skating and a tea with Mrs. Claus, so one mountain trip can cover several days.
lastyear: The Big Bear Alpine Zoo lists Wild Lights on a season that began November 13 and runs through January 3, and Visit Big Bear shows the Santa Paws day as a returning zoo event. SkyPark at Santa's Village runs a holiday season from November 7 to January 10 with nightly tree lighting and skating. The Lake Arrowhead Village events page lists its Santa schedule and notes that its own tree lighting on November 21 has already passed. The Visit Big Bear listings for the tree lighting and holiday competition give 2026 dates for the City of Big Bear Lake and the Chamber.
facts: Big Bear Lake sits in the San Bernardino Mountains, and the Village is the walkable heart of town, with the tree at Village Drive and Pine Knot Avenue. The Big Bear Alpine Zoo is on Moonridge Road, a short drive from the Village. Lake Arrowhead and Skyforest are on the Rim of the World Highway to the west, with SkyPark on Highway 18 and the Village on Highway 189. Because these are mountain roads, check weather and chain requirements before driving up in winter, and give yourself extra time on holiday weekends.
trains: There is no verified holiday train ride in Big Bear Lake or Lake Arrowhead for 2026 on the host pages we checked. SkyPark at Santa's Village offers skating, shows and Santa visits, and the Alpine Zoo has its Wild Lights trail. For rail fun in the Inland Empire, ask our guides for nearby towns, and check each host's website for dates and ticket prices before planning the trip.
traditions: The City of Big Bear Lake lights the tree at Christmas Tree Corner the day after Thanksgiving.
An evening light show at the Big Bear Alpine Zoo with Santa Paws visits on December 12 and 19.
A self guided community lights contest across the valley all December.
SkyPark in Skyforest runs nightly tree lighting, skating, Breakfast with Santa and Tea with Mrs. Claus.
Santa visits The Lake Arrowhead Village from noon to 3 pm with free selfies.
kidfact: At the Big Bear Alpine Zoo, Wild Lights admission is $20 and children under 5 are free.
faq: When is the Big Bear Village tree lighting in 2026?
It is on Friday, November 27, 2026, from 4:30 to 7 pm at Christmas Tree Corner in Big Bear Village.
Is there a light show in Big Bear?
Yes. Wild Lights at the Big Bear Alpine Zoo runs through January 3, Thursday to Sunday from 5 to 8 pm and daily during holiday weeks.
Where can kids meet Santa near Big Bear?
Santa Paws is at the zoo on December 12 and 19, Santa visits SkyPark at Santa's Village, and Santa is at The Lake Arrowhead Village from noon to 3 pm on listed dates.
Are there free Christmas events in Big Bear?
Santa at The Lake Arrowhead Village lists free selfies. Several listings print no price.
Where can I find more Christmas events near Big Bear Lake?
San Bernardino, Yucaipa and Rancho Cucamonga each have their own guide on this site.
sources: Visit Big Bear and the Big Bear Chamber
